info.title: ZeroDoc — generate a self-contained HTML or Markdown API reference for a .NET assembly.
info.description: Command-line tool that generates a self-contained HTML API reference for a .NET assembly from its XML documentation. A Swagger/DocFX alternative for class libraries.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: html (default) or markdown / md.

options.name: --xml
options.description: XML doc file (default: <assembly>.xml next to the dll).

options.name: --readme
options.description: Markdown/text file shown on the overview page.
